figures.source: CALIBRATED 2026-09 (kernel.ts DEFAULT_OOS_RATE_THRESHOLD). The lowest TESTED ProcurableProductOutOfStockRate that reproduces the vendor engine's published availability-interruption counts, at a fixed sellable floor of 40. Rates 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.25 / 0.30 / 0.40 / 0.50 / 0.75 / 0.90 / 0.99 were run; the target reproduces at 0.25 and 0.30 only, with UNTESTED bands (0.20, 0.25] and (0.30, 0.40] on either side, so the true edges are not known. N: ONE vendor account, TWO months (July and August 2026), and a July target of a SINGLE ASIN-day. Not a fleet rate and not confirmed on a second account. Full grid: skills/mx-monthly-report-max/rules-provenance.md. Was 0.99 before this deploy.

CALIBRATED 2026-09 (kernel.ts DEFAULT_MIN_SELLABLE_UNITS). The lowest TESTED sellable-unit floor that reproduces the same target, at a fixed rate of 0.25. Floors 1 / 25 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 75 / 150 were run; the target reproduces at 40, 50, 75 and 150. July is the binding constraint (floor 30 gives July 2, floor 40 gives July 1); the true lower edge lies in the UNTESTED band (30, 40] and no upper edge was found because the grid stopped at 150. Each interval was measured with the OTHER knob held fixed, so a pair drawn from both far corners was never run. Same N as oos_rate_threshold. A fixed unit count, never a share of run rate. Full grid: skills/mx-monthly-report-max/rules-provenance.md. Did not exist before this deploy.

figures.servedAs: thresholds_applied.settled_exclusion_days (Seller Central battery; thresholds_applied.settled_exclusion_days.SC on the brand battery)
figures.source: DEFINITIONAL, not tuned (kernel.ts SETTLE_DAYS_SC). Days excluded at the end of a window for the settled-efficiency check: the attribution tail that is still filling in. Seller Central attributes Sponsored Products on 7 days, so the tail is 7. Follows the attribution basis: --attribution all_14 makes it 14 everywhere and sc_default makes it 7 everywhere, and thresholds_applied.settled_exclusion_days reports what actually ran.
